discovery_notes: All claims are search snippets only (28 searches). DPB monthly 2017 DLP posts give only themes and event dates. TTM April says 5 LE pins of 700 each while DPB PTD gives 600/600/600/500 for 4 PTD pins; TTM 700 figure kept on april-2017-le set only, not applied to PTD pins. PTD split one pin per character is stated by source (per-character sizes). PTN 100 split into Flounder/Eric/Triton stated as three pins by racontemoi. Resale-only leads not recorded: Mickey Halloween 2017 LE 700, Lady castle LE 700 (whatnot), Lilo/Alice PTN LE 400 (no year). Jumbo price EUR 42.99 from unreadable PDF guide not recorded.
